what: When you hover a link holding the “See all” arrow, the current arrow slides 12px to the right while fading, and the same arrow enters from 12px on the left and settles in place (.2s ease). On release it returns in reverse. In the “back” type, the previous arrow pointing left exits to the left

options.look: back: Previous arrow — points left and exits to the left (slider previous button)
options.> :first-child · > :last-child: Same arrow graphic twice (two SVGs) — the first one leaves and the second one comes in
options.look: slide: Instead of fading, the text is pushed out of the box (overflow hidden) while the next arrow is pushed in — set --fx-shift equal to --fx-w (hotel-uro: 62px · .5s · cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)).
options.--fx-fade: Blur duration (set via style), same as the default --fx-dur — for when the blur should be shorter than the slide (Brand .4s)
options.--fx-from: Distance on the left where the incoming arrow starts (via style), default same as --fx-shift
options.--fx-delay: Delay on entry only (via style), default 0s — Brand circle arrow .2s
options.leave: snap: On release it returns to place immediately with no transition (transition only on entry) — Brand (the original has a transition only on :hover)
options.dir: up: Slides out upward and comes in from below at --fx-from (default --fx-shift) — for flipping a diagonal ↗ arrow vertically. Used together with look: slide (Brand site)
options.--fx-in-delay: Delay only on the entering side (via style), default --fx-delay — the leaving side goes immediately (Studio roll .1s)
options.dir: down: Drops down and enters from --fx-from above — menu text roll (16px · .8s)
options.look: text: When two sets of text overlap — the front set takes its place so the box follows the text size (without --fx-w and --fx-h)
options.pace: split: Duration on enter is set by --fx-in-dur (default .8s) and on release by --fx-dur, separately — STUDIO :hover transition (brand enter .8s · release .2s)
options.dir: left: Without flipping the image, it exits to the left and enters from the right --fx-from — for when a separate left-arrow image is used (Brand previous button)
options.pace: relay: The current arrow slides out through the front half while the new arrow enters in the back half (a relay with no overlap). On release it passes once more in the same direction — brand (--fx-shift 100% · .36s ease-out)
options.pace: keyframes: Instead of a transition, keyframes (forwards) are attached only on :hover — the current arrow leaves over --fx-dur and a new arrow enters --fx-in-delay later, and when the pointer leaves the animation is removed and it snaps straight back to rest on the next frame. Used with look: slide (brand .5s ease · second one .2s later)
options.--fx-in-ease: Curve for the incoming arrow only (via style), default --fx-ease — used when it differs from the outgoing side (Brand pill: outgoing ease · incoming cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1))
